originalTitle: 80% of S&P 500 stocks are in correction territory. These 3 are still buys
summary: With more than 80% of S&P 500 stocks down at least 10% from their highs, Ted Thatcher, founder and president of Bright Lake Wealth Management, reveals why he’s bullish on Nvidia, Microsoft and Alphabet.
content: With more than 80% of S&P 500 stocks down at least 10% from their highs, Ted Thatcher, founder and president of Bright Lake Wealth Management, reveals why he’s bullish on Nvidia, Microsoft and Alphabet.
